breakdown.description: Initializing turbulent kinetic energy (k) and dissipation rate (epsilon) to exactly zero is incorrect for a RANS simulation, as it leads to a division-by-zero error in the turbulent viscosity calculation (nut = Cmu * k²/epsilon) and prevents turbulence from developing.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the initialization of k and epsilon at all. It is merely a follow-up question about pressure boundary conditions, completely unrelated to the inconsistency. The zero-initialization error from the incomplete prompt was not corrected, and no physically plausible non-zero values (such as k ≈ 0.00375 and epsilon ≈ 0.001) were provided.
